findings.desc: Scanning only seven named files allowed an additional committed or untracked evidence log to bypass secret and IP checks.
Short libpq conninfo and PostgreSQL environment assignments were not rejected independently of value length and punctuation.
JSON artifacts were scanned only as serialized bytes, allowing escaped IP addresses, URLs, and sensitive key names to bypass detection.
Separate lstat and read operations left a time-of-check/time-of-use path replacement window.
The unconditional IPv4 rule also rejected the approved non-identifying pre-window all-IPv4 sentinel.
The GitHub token rule omitted the ghu, ghs, and ghr token prefixes.
The rule-set digest bound only rule identifiers rather than executable rule definitions or scanner source.
